title: Polymer-Based Shaping Strategy for Zeolite Templated Carbons (ZTC) and Their Metal Organic Framework (MOF) Composites for Improved Hydrogen Storage Properties
material_description: Pristine ZTC | zeolite-templated carbon: zeolite 13X (24 g, dried 120 C 12 h) impregnated with furfuryl alcohol, polymerised at 80 C 24 h and 150 C 8 h under Ar, heated to 700 C under Ar, ethylene/argon (10% ethylene) CVD at 700 C for 3 h, carbonized at 900 C for 3 h under Ar; zeolite removed with HF/HCl
purification_method: template removal: 10% aqueous HF 24 h, dilution to 2 L with deionised water and filtration, reflux in 10% aqueous HCl 24 h, washing with 2 L deionised water, vacuum-oven drying at 120 C for 12 h
functional_groups: C=O (FTIR ~1,720 cm-1); carbonyl (FTIR ~1,600 cm-1); C-O (FTIR 1,000-1,400 cm-1)
source_location: main-07.png (p. 7), Figure 6, series 'ZTC' (dark green left-pointing triangles), marker 1 of 19
notes: archive: HYC-0042_fig6_ZTC.json; digitized pressure 12.037 mbar (axis printed in mbar), converted to bar. First marker overlaps the PIM-1 square; centroid from the visible green pixels. Basis not named (Table 1 footnote e: 'Hydrogen adsorbed at 77 K and 1 bar'); H2 isotherms 'up to 1 bar' from a 'Micrometrics ASAP 2020 HD analyser at 77 K' (volumetric analyser; the text does not name the method), so measurement_method = volumetric_sieverts and basis_inferred = excess by the volumetric default. Degassing: 'under vacuum (down to 10^-7 bar) at 200 C for at least 8 h' (degas_end_pressure_pa converted from 10^-7 bar; 8 h is a minimum). H2 gas 'ultra-high purity grade' (no number). Free-volume determination not described. BET from N2 adsorption isotherms at 77 K (Table 1 footnote a), BET range not stated; micropore area from t-plot (footnote c); total pore volume 'determined from H-K analysis by uptake at p/p ~0.99' (footnote d; probe gas N2 inferred from the relative pressure and the N2 isotherms of Figure 5).
measuring_lab_id: Musyoka group, Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)
